$note: Manual integration slots. Each entry is a clearly-scoped place where an authorised external system plugs in. NOTHING here is fake-wired: features remain functional without these integrations, and integrations are only claimed after actual authorisation and technical integration (see INTEGRATIONS.md).

slots.name: Supabase PostgreSQL (production database)
slots.status: SLOT READY — awaiting authorised credentials + migration + persistence test
steps: Set DATABASE_PROVIDER=postgres and DATABASE_URL in the deployment environment
Run: npm run db:migrate (executes schema.sql against PostgreSQL)
Run: npm run db:seed (provisions officer/dept-head/admin accounts)
Verify migration, insert, read, update, transaction, restart, redeploy and persistence before calling the cloud deployment complete
